bio: Shirley Ho is a group leader at the Flatiron Institute's Center for Computational Astrophysics and principal investigator of Polymathic AI. Their research applies machine learning to cosmology and astrophysics. Ho is senior author of the Multiple Physics Pretraining paper, an early foundation-model approach for physical simulations.
